questions.q: According to Tracy, what separates high achievers from everyone else?
questions.why: The overview says Tracy treats self-discipline as the key to any goal, without which talent and luck fall short.

questions.q: How much of your income does Tracy suggest spending on self-improvement?
questions.why: Lesson 1 recommends allocating 3 percent of your income and a little daily time to moving toward excellence.

questions.q: What is the first step of Tracy's Seven-Step Method?
questions.why: Lesson 1 lists defining the goal precisely as step one, before writing it down and setting deadlines.

questions.q: Which ingredient of happiness involves saving part of your income?
questions.why: Lesson 2 suggests living on 99 percent of your income and saving 1 percent to build freedom from money.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the Disaster Report?
a: To defuse fear by describing the worst case
To track progress toward your goals
To warn others about risky decisions
To record every mistake you make at work
questions.why: Lesson 3 says writing down the worst-case scenario makes it lose some of its scary power.
